# Fixture robots.txt. Deliberately includes directives that are commonly mishandled.

User-agent: *
Crawl-delay: 1
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /trap/

# A second group that must NOT apply to us — a parser that merges groups will wrongly
# think everything is disallowed.
User-agent: BadBot
Disallow: /

Sitemap: http://localhost:8099/sitemap.xml
